name: Super Lucky's Tale Guardian Trials
storyline:
Lucky returns for his most daunting challenge yet in “Guardian Trials”, a dazzling new chapter for Super Lucky’s Tale. After saving Gilly Island, Lucky’s big sister Lyra believes the time has come for him to meet his destiny and embark on the journey to become a full-fledged Guardian.

Lyra enlists the help of a few lively friends pulled straight from the Book of Ages, and together they’ve set up a series of insurmountable challenges that only a true Guardian could possibly conquer. Now, with your help, Lucky must puzzle, leap, burrow, and roll his way through a hilariously retro bootcamp that’s tougher than any epic training montage! Along the way, you’ll meet zany characters, best classic platforming challenges, defeat souped up bosses, solve perplexing puzzles and earn your right to stand with Lyra as an official Guardian of the Book of Ages.
